## СНГБ — Company.id 4461

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": "\u0421\u0443\u0440\u0433\u0443\u0442\u043d\u0435\u0444\u0442\u0435\u0433\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0430\u043d\u043a",
  "id": 4461,
  "title": "\u0421\u041d\u0413\u0411",
  "url": "sngb.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-02T16:38:54.095759Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- No existing icon.svg at frozen base commit; this is the first icon addition.
- Selected source material SVG: [source.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/a24917bee8f43c4b691bdb17bed0c2301ecafccf/review-materials/4461/source.svg) — SHA-256 `aaeed03c1e4516fb51ca3d5d89ce3a82f7187e2bcc4e4eb79f6aaa7f6ce6d35d`.

- Source page: [https://www.sngb.ru/](https://www.sngb.ru/).
- Source asset: [https://www.sngb.ru/local/templates/sngb/assets/cd91b177/img/logo.svg](https://www.sngb.ru/local/templates/sngb/assets/cd91b177/img/logo.svg).


### Source material origin

Member selection (URI-encoded identifiers): direct resource.
Replayed operations: none.
The source file is the exact selected material, not the whole container or an adapted SVG.

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-02T16:14:00Z: [https://www.sngb.ru/](https://www.sngb.ru/); asset [https://www.sngb.ru/local/templates/sngb/assets/cd91b177/img/logo.svg](https://www.sngb.ru/local/templates/sngb/assets/cd91b177/img/logo.svg). Official site header binds the logo.svg asset via production widgets CSS \(.wp-widget-header .logo\); the SVG \(107568 bytes, Illustrator-exported\) contains the rhombus emblem \(fill #004282, lens #FDB913\), the СНГБ lettering and the slogan line as separate top-level paths. (independence group: official-site).
- official checked 2026-10-02T16:14:00Z: [https://cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1027800000040](https://cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1027800000040). Bank of Russia registry and credit-organization list \(checked 2026-10-01 by the research pass, reg. 588, general license 05.09.2016\) confirm Сургутнефтегазбанк \(СНГБ\) is operating; current site branding is the relevant period. (independence group: regulator).
- third-party checked 2026-10-02T16:14:00Z: [https://www.acra-ratings.ru/](https://www.acra-ratings.ru/). ACRA February 2026 press release confirms ongoing operations of СНГБ, corroborating currency of the current logo. (independence group: rating-agency).
- Independent evidence: Official site asset, CBR registry and an independent rating-agency publication are separate sources; the CSS binding of the asset to the header was verified in the site's own stylesheet..
- Identity: confirmed — The official sngb.ru site \(Сургутнефтегазбанк, fullTitle in metadata\) serves logo.svg as its header brand asset; the emblem is the bank's rhombus mark used with the СНГБ wordmark..
- Currency: confirmed — Operating bank per CBR registry and ACRA 2026; the live site asset is the current presentation..
- Variant: confirmed — The primary site-wide header variant: blue rhombus with yellow lens beside the СНГБ wordmark; emblem colors #004282/#FDB913 as drawn in the official asset..
- Uncertainty: Catalog suitability of the full lockup requires dropping the СНГБ wordmark and slogan; only the standalone rhombus emblem is proposed..

Rationale: First addition for an existing record without an icon. The operating bank's official header SVG is a genuine original vector; the standalone rhombus emblem was selected losslessly \(two verbatim original paths, wordmark and slogan removed for catalog suitability\) and optimized with SVGO..
Role: Standalone brand emblem \(blue rhombus with yellow lens\) extracted from the official header lockup; the СНГБ wordmark and the slogan line are excluded per catalog suitability.; variant: Original vector emblem on a transparent field; no circular catalog backing applied because the mark is a suitable transparent standalone symbol whose rhombus contour and internal transparent lens gap are preserved..

Details: Rhombus geometry, yellow lens shape and the transparent gap between lens and rhombus survive optimization and rendering on both themes; no lost detail or color shift. The transparent gap shows the theme background exactly as the source structure defines.. Proportions: The emblem is a wide \(about 2:1\) mark; it fills its viewBox with balanced margins, stays complete and legible at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes, with the lens clearly visible..

Source-to-final transformations:
- Lossless selection of the first two original paths \(#FDB913 lens, #004282 rhombus\) from the fetched lockup; wordmark/slogan paths dropped; no geometry, color or alpha edits \(working.svg, 863 bytes\).
- SVGO 4.1.0 with repository config svgo.config.mjs \(sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\), multipass: 863 -\> 750 bytes; selected \(optimized.svg sha256 2939240f5e37f365097063c0cc4679c14bd6e70ce102c2a1fc4de7b85ccd730e\); pixel comparison of working versus optimized renders showed no difference \(max-diff bbox none\); viewport preserved.
- No placement transform needed: the emblem fills its 36.01x18.1 viewBox; whole-emblem geometry untouched.
